title: [EXA-14] Example domains that are not example.com or example.net, including one real company domain
description: Review finding EXA-14: Example domains that are not example.com or example.net, including one real company domain (lens EXA). Location: spec/10-relays.md:221 only. Fix: Part of this finding is wrong. `.example` is an RFC 2606 reserved TLD, so `acme.example`, `turn-creds.acme.example` and `agency.example` are valid. `raw.githubusercontent.com` is deliberate: 10:317 says "A file committed to a public GitHub repository and served via `raw.githubusercontent.com` ... is a valid directory", and the path uses the `example` org. Only `/ipns/agora.protocol/relays/v1` remains a defect: it is an unowned name that reads as normative. Replace it with "an IPNS name configured by the operator (e.g. `/ipns/bootstrap.example.com`)". Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
